text:
mia: Quick design check — microcopy for the threshold helper: should we say `Alert when error rate > 5% for 5m` or `Notify if error rate exceeds 5% over 5 minutes`? I lean short for compact rows.
ashley: I prefer the explicit one: 'Notify if...' reads better for non-technical PMs and legal. short is nice but can be ambiguous.
sam: a11y / keyboard nav note: when opening the channel picklist the focus should land in the search input, not the first checkbox. VoiceOver users expect a text field first.
joel: Also a preview ask — if a channel group is collapsed, can the compact preview still show a single example notification line (like a condensed tooltip) so people know which channels will get it without expanding?
mia: Good call. Proposed microcopy variants for devs to pick:
1) `Alert when error rate > 5% for 5m`
2) `Notify if error rate exceeds 5% over 5 minutes`
3) `Trigger when errors > 5% for 5 minutes (recommended)`
Which should be the default?
ashley: I'd vote 2 as default, 1 as the compact alt shown in the channel list (smaller visual footprint). 3 feels opinionated and might confuse.
dev: I implemented the picklist focus change in feat/threshold-a11y — ready for review. Quick snippet: ```html
<input aria-label="Channel search" class="channel-search" />
```
sam: small nit on threshold control: slider should use finer granularity under 1% (0.1%) and coarser above (1%). Right now it's jumping 1% always which is annoying for low-rate services.
joel: Agree. Can we also show a little live preview line under the slider that translates numbers into plain english, e.g. "~ 10 errors / 1k requests" when selecting a rate? That helps non-metric folks.
mia: Nice. For the collapsed-channel preview, UX suggestion: add a subtle chevron + tiny sample message on hover. Keeps the list dense while still conveying send behavior.
ashley: Copy nit: change 'quiet window' label to 'silence notifications' or 'snooze notifications' ? 'Quiet window' confused a legal reviewer.
sam: +1 'snooze notifications' is more common. ensure we include a tooltip explaining scope (per-rule vs org-wide).
dev: FYI I pushed the slider step change and the preview line to the branch, but need the final microcopy to update tests.
mia: I'll update Figma with the chosen copy (we're decided on variant 2 as default, short form shown in compact contexts) and attach a screenshot in follow-up.
joel: accessibility QA: please confirm the live preview text updates for screenreaders (aria-live polite) when the slider moves.
ashley: I'll add that to the QA checklist.
dev: added `aria-live="polite"` in the branch and left a comment for QA.
mia: Awesome. Thanks team — I'll post the Figma link once updated. :thumbsup:
